en.title_tag: Electrolux Washing Machine Error E59: Stop and Service
en.meta_description: Electrolux washer showing E59? Check the verified meaning, how to make it safe and why authorised service is required.
en.h1: What Does E59 Mean on an Electrolux Washing Machine?
en.description: Official Electrolux documentation identifies E59 as no motor-tachometer signal for three seconds, with possible motor-inverter wiring, inverter-board or motor causes.
en.quick_fix: Switch off immediately, unplug if the area is dry and safe, turn off the water tap and arrange authorised Electrolux service (about 5 minutes).
en.intro_html:
Official Electrolux documentation identifies E59 as no motor-tachometer signal for three seconds, with possible motor-inverter wiring, inverter-board or motor causes.

Switch off immediately, unplug if the area is dry and safe, turn off the water tap and arrange authorised Electrolux service. Do not restart to test a motor, heating, overheating or earth-leakage fault.

causes_json.detail: Electrolux states that the control system receives no expected feedback from the motor.
Internal connections require safe inspection by a trained technician.
Power electronics may need model-specific diagnosis for the correct PNC.
The code alone does not confirm which component needs replacement.

steps_json.detail: Wait for the drum to stop. Do not force the door or try to continue the programme.
Unplug with dry hands if the area is dry. If moisture is near electricity, isolate power safely elsewhere.
Leave the washer without water and power until professionally inspected.
Photograph the complete E59 display and note the PNC/product number and programme stage.
A reset does not confirm that the motor, heating or insulation fault is safe.
Provide the PNC and full code. Do not remove panels or test the motor, inverter, heater, sensor or earth circuit.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
E59 requires authorised Electrolux service. E62 and E68 are particularly safety-critical because they concern overheating and electrical leakage to earth.

Isolate power safely for a burning smell, smoke, abnormal heat, leakage near electricity or tripped protection.
en.prevention_html:
Follow load, installation and programme instructions for the exact PNC and stop when a motor or heating code appears.

Internal motor, heating and insulation faults cannot be safely prevented or diagnosed through user maintenance.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using a Bosch washer showing E59?
faq_json.answer: Switch off immediately, unplug if the area is dry and safe, turn off the water tap and arrange authorised Electrolux service. Do not run another cycle until Bosch guidance or service confirms it is safe.

faq_json.question: Can I reset E59 by switching the washer off?
faq_json.answer: Switching off is a safety step, not proof that the fault is repaired. If the code returns or Bosch classifies it as service-only, do not repeatedly reset the washer.

faq_json.question: Does E59 identify a part to replace?
faq_json.answer: No. The code identifies a system or condition, but Bosch service should diagnose the exact cause before any part is ordered.

faq_json.question: Why should I provide the E-Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch model families and markets can use different hardware and service procedures. The E-Nr identifies the correct appliance documentation.

faq_json.question: May I test the sensor myself?
faq_json.answer: No. Do not remove panels or measure internal wiring, sensors or electronics. Bosch directs these codes to customer service.

sv.title_tag: Electrolux tvättmaskin felkod E59: stoppa och boka service
sv.meta_description: Visar Electrolux-tvättmaskinen E59? Läs verifierad betydelse, hur maskinen säkras och varför auktoriserad service krävs.
sv.h1: Vad betyder E59 på en Electrolux-tvättmaskin?
sv.description: Officiell electrolux-dokumentation anger att e59 betyder att signal saknas från motorns varvtalsgivare i tre sekunder, med möjliga orsaker i motor–inverter-kablage, inverterkort eller motor.
sv.quick_fix: Stäng av omedelbart, dra ur kontakten om området är torrt och säkert, stäng vattenkranen och boka auktoriserad Electrolux-service (cirka 5 minuter).
sv.intro_html:
Officiell electrolux-dokumentation anger att e59 betyder att signal saknas från motorns varvtalsgivare i tre sekunder, med möjliga orsaker i motor–inverter-kablage, inverterkort eller motor.

Stäng av omedelbart, dra ur kontakten om området är torrt och säkert, stäng vattenkranen och boka auktoriserad Electrolux-service. Starta inte om för att testa ett motor-, värme-, överhettnings- eller jordfel.

causes_json.detail: Electrolux anger att styrsystemet inte får förväntad återkoppling från motorn.
Interna anslutningar kräver säker kontroll av utbildad tekniker.
Effektelektroniken kan behöva modellspecifik diagnos för rätt PNC.
Koden ensam bekräftar inte vilken komponent som ska bytas.

steps_json.detail: Vänta tills trumman står stilla. Tvinga inte luckan och försök inte fortsätta programmet.

steps_json.action: Stäng av och koppla ur säkert
steps_json.detail: Dra ur kontakten med torra händer om området är torrt. Finns fukt nära el bryter du strömmen säkert på annan plats.
Lämna maskinen utan vatten och ström tills professionell kontroll är utförd.
Fotografera hela E59-visningen och notera PNC-/produktnummer och programfas.
En återställning bekräftar inte att motor-, värme- eller isolationsfelet är säkert.
Uppge PNC och full kod. Ta inte bort paneler och testa inte motor, inverter, värmare, givare eller jordkrets.

sv.when_to_call_technician_html:
E59 kräver auktoriserad Electrolux-service. E62 och E68 är särskilt säkerhetskritiska på grund av överhettning respektive elektriskt läckage mot jord.

Isolera strömmen säkert vid bränd lukt, rök, onormal värme, läckage nära el eller utlöst elskydd.
sv.prevention_html:
Följ last-, installations- och programanvisningarna för exakt PNC och avbryt när en motor- eller värmekod visas.

Interna motor-, värme- och isolationsfel kan inte förebyggas eller diagnostiseras säkert genom användarunderhåll.

faq_json.question: Kan jag fortsätta använda maskinen med E59?
faq_json.answer: Stäng av omedelbart, dra ur kontakten om området är torrt och säkert, stäng vattenkranen och boka auktoriserad Electrolux-service. Kör inte ett nytt program innan Bosch eller en servicetekniker har bekräftat att det är säkert.

faq_json.question: Kan jag återställa E59 genom att stänga av?
faq_json.answer: Avstängning är en säkerhetsåtgärd, inte bevis på att felet är löst. Återställ inte maskinen upprepade gånger om koden återkommer.

faq_json.question: Visar E59 vilken reservdel som ska bytas?
faq_json.answer: Nej. Koden identifierar ett system eller tillstånd, men Bosch service ska diagnostisera den exakta orsaken före beställning.

faq_json.question: Varför behöver Bosch E‑Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch-serier och marknader kan ha olika maskinvara och serviceförfaranden. E‑Nr identifierar rätt dokumentation.

faq_json.question: Kan jag själv testa sensorn?
faq_json.answer: Nej. Ta inte bort paneler och mät inte interna ledningar, sensorer eller elektronik. Bosch hänvisar dessa koder till service.

en.title_tag: Electrolux Washing Machine Error E68: Stop and Service
en.meta_description: Electrolux washer showing E68? Check the verified meaning, how to make it safe and why authorised service is required.
en.h1: What Does E68 Mean on an Electrolux Washing Machine?
en.description: Official Electrolux service documentation identifies E68 as electrical current leakage between the washing heater and earth.
en.quick_fix: Switch off immediately, unplug if the area is dry and safe, turn off the water tap and arrange authorised Electrolux service (about 5 minutes).
en.intro_html:
Official Electrolux service documentation identifies E68 as electrical current leakage between the washing heater and earth.

Switch off immediately, unplug if the area is dry and safe, turn off the water tap and arrange authorised Electrolux service. Do not restart to test a motor, heating, overheating or earth-leakage fault.

causes_json.detail: Official Electrolux service documentation identifies E68 as electrical current leakage between the washing heater and earth.
The NTC sensor or its position can affect temperature sensing and needs internal diagnosis.
The heating circuit uses mains voltage and is not a user measurement.
Heating control and earth-leakage monitoring require the correct service data and equipment.

steps_json.detail: Wait for the drum to stop. Do not force the door or try to continue the programme.
Unplug with dry hands if the area is dry. If moisture is near electricity, isolate power safely elsewhere.
Leave the washer without water and power until professionally inspected.
Photograph the complete E68 display and note the PNC/product number and programme stage.
A reset does not confirm that the motor, heating or insulation fault is safe.
Provide the PNC and full code. Do not remove panels or test the motor, inverter, heater, sensor or earth circuit.

en.when_to_call_technician_html:
E68 requires authorised Electrolux service. E62 and E68 are particularly safety-critical because they concern overheating and electrical leakage to earth.

Isolate power safely for a burning smell, smoke, abnormal heat, leakage near electricity or tripped protection.
en.prevention_html:
Follow load, installation and programme instructions for the exact PNC and stop when a motor or heating code appears.

Internal motor, heating and insulation faults cannot be safely prevented or diagnosed through user maintenance.

faq_json.question: Can I keep using a Bosch washer showing E68?
faq_json.answer: Switch off immediately, unplug if the area is dry and safe, turn off the water tap and arrange authorised Electrolux service. Do not run another cycle until Bosch guidance or service confirms it is safe.

faq_json.question: Can I reset E68 by switching the washer off?
faq_json.answer: Switching off is a safety step, not proof that the fault is repaired. If the code returns or Bosch classifies it as service-only, do not repeatedly reset the washer.

faq_json.question: Does E68 identify a part to replace?
faq_json.answer: No. The code identifies a system or condition, but Bosch service should diagnose the exact cause before any part is ordered.

faq_json.question: Why should I provide the E-Nr?
faq_json.answer: Bosch model families and markets can use different hardware and service procedures. The E-Nr identifies the correct appliance documentation.

faq_json.question: May I test the sensor myself?
faq_json.answer: No. Do not remove panels or measure internal wiring, sensors or electronics. Bosch directs these codes to customer service.
